exodus.29.p1.b1.text: “Now this is what you are to do to consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve Me as priests: Take a young bull and two rams without blemish,

exodus.29.p1.b2.text: Then present Aaron and his sons at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.

exodus.29.p1.b3.text: Then take the anointing oil and anoint him by pouring it on his head.

exodus.29.p1.b4.text: Wrap the sashes around Aaron and his sons and tie headbands on them. The priesthood shall be theirs by a permanent statute. …

exodus.29.p2.b5.text: You are to present the bull at the front of the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron and his sons are to lay their hands on its head.

exodus.29.p2.b6.text: Take some of the blood of the bull and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger …

exodus.29.p2.b7.text: But burn the flesh of the bull and its hide and dung outside the camp; it is a sin offering.

exodus.29.p2.b8.text: Then burn the entire ram on the altar; it is a burnt offering to the LORD, a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

exodus.29.p3.b10.text: … Then he and his garments will be consecrated, as well as his sons and their garments.

exodus.29.p3.b9.text: … take some of its blood, and put it on the right earlobes of Aaron and his sons, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. …

exodus.29.p3.b11.text: Put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and wave them before the LORD as a wave offering.

exodus.29.p4.b12.text: The holy garments that belong to Aaron will belong to his sons after him, so they can be anointed and ordained in them.

exodus.29.p4.b13.text: At the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, Aaron and his sons are to eat the meat of the ram and the bread that is in the basket.

exodus.29.p4.b14.text: … if any of the meat of ordination or any bread is left until the morning, you are to burn up the remainder. It must not be eaten, because it is sacred.

exodus.29.p4.b15.text: For seven days you shall make atonement for the altar and consecrate it. Then the altar will become most holy; whatever touches the altar will be holy.

exodus.29.p5.b16.text: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight.

exodus.29.p5.b17.text: For the generations to come, this burnt offering shall be made regularly at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD, where I will meet you to speak with you.

exodus.29.p5.b18.text: Then I will dwell among the Israelites and be their God.

exodus.29.p5.b19.text: And they will know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt so that I might dwell among them. …
